allies.rationale_text: Decision-trees helps counterfactual-reasoning recover the missing branches that make the original choice intelligible.
allies.source_quote: It allows decision-makers to view the outcome that occurred in the context of other potential outcomes at the time of the decision, helping to re-create the decision tree.
allies.affinity_rationale: Structural tool — 'allows decision-makers to view the outcome that occurred alongside alternative outcomes' — provides the branching framework for organizing counterfactual scenarios, but is a tool rather than the reasoning mode itself.
allies.activation_condition: When counterfactual alternatives need to be organized into a structured branching framework that makes it possible to compare the actual outcome against what would have happened under different choices

allies.rationale_text: Premortem gives counterfactual-reasoning a concrete way to work backward from failure and expose hidden branches before commitment.
allies.affinity_rationale: Operational application — 'Conduct a Pre-Mortem' — the pre-mortem IS counterfactual reasoning applied prospectively before commitment, making it the most direct team-level application of the model.
allies.activation_condition: When prospective counterfactual reasoning needs to be structured as a team exercise that imagines the project has already failed and works backward to identify what went wrong

allies.rationale_text: Systems-thinking strengthens counterfactual-reasoning by surfacing interrelationships and unknown unknowns across the wider system.
allies.source_quote: CR helps reveal interrelationships and unexpected results.
allies.affinity_rationale: Scope expander — 'CR helps reveal interrelationships and unexpected results' — ensures counterfactual scenarios account for system-level interdependencies rather than tracing only the most obvious single-variable alternatives.
allies.activation_condition: When counterfactual analysis needs to account for system-level interdependencies and feedback loops rather than varying only a single obvious factor in isolation

antagonists.rationale_text: Confirmation-bias undermines counterfactual-reasoning by resisting the search for plausible opposite explanations.
antagonists.source_quote: CR directly opposes this by forcing the consideration of disconfirming evidence.
antagonists.affinity_rationale: Directly opposed — 'CR directly opposes this by forcing the consideration of disconfirming evidence' — confirmation bias constructs counterfactuals that conveniently confirm the actual decision was correct.
antagonists.activation_condition: When counterfactual scenarios are being constructed only to reinforce the belief that the actual decision was correct rather than genuinely exploring what would have happened under different choices

antagonists.rationale_text: Anchoring works against counterfactual-reasoning when the first judgment or first shared view narrows the branch set too early.
antagonists.source_quote: This prevents anchoring (focusing too much on a single piece of information) and ensures that alternative perspectives are generated organically.
antagonists.affinity_rationale: Limits scenario range — 'This prevents anchoring (focusing too much on a single piece of information)' — the actual outcome becomes an anchor that constrains the range of counterfactual alternatives considered.
antagonists.activation_condition: When the actual outcome is anchoring the counterfactual analysis so that alternative scenarios cluster narrowly around what happened rather than exploring genuinely different trajectories

structured_tensions.tension_text: Counterfactual-reasoning conflicts with confirmation-bias when teams search for support for the winning story instead of realistic alternatives.
structured_tensions.source_quote: When tackling a problem, team members often see support for our hypotheses in the faintest clues, while overlooking more significant, yet disconfirming information.

curation_notes.summary: Layer 1+2 enrichment complete. Allies: premortem 0.90 (strong — direct prospective application), decision-trees 0.80 (moderate — structural tool), systems-thinking 0.80 (moderate — scope expander). Antagonists: confirmation-bias 0.90 (strong — constructs self-serving counterfactuals), anchoring 0.80 (moderate — limits scenario range). Activation conditions assigned.
donor_drops: Did not preserve donor multihop or scenario catalogs because this batch stops at first-order relations only.
open_questions: Hypothesis-driven problem solving is source-real, but decision-trees and premortem were the cleaner bounded anchors into the current graph vocabulary.
